scope: Independent root source review of steady-frame synchronization and actual frozen31b original-renderer counters. No new benchmark or test executions in this audit.

findings.result: No explicit GPU completion wait or pixel readback in worker draw. Queue submission precedes presentation reply. Surface acquire/reconfigure may block inside backend, confined to GPU actor.
Three bounded control slots recycle after CPU submission, not GPU completion. Ordered queue writes precede next submission. Fourth unsubmitted frame refuses safely.

4ms actor fallback park is interrupted by Wake::ring on request. Main16ms pending deadline is interrupted by production event-loop proxy. Neither is a mandatory hardware-frame delay. Uncapped Mailbox/Immediate uses zero frame interval, disabling1ms idle receive condition. No source removal justified.

set_atlas/grow_atlas/reserve_atlas/finish_atlas_transfer_sync retain startup/offscreen compatibility waits for bounded memory retirement. Actual runtime art growth/replacement uses nonblocking begin/advance/adopt and retirement callbacks. Keep finite residency guarantees.

GPU queries use bounded asynchronous readback. Skipped queries and nonadjacent IDs cannot become GPU idle estimates. GPU gap includes pacing/uploads and is correctly labelled approximate; it does not prove pure CPU starvation.
Main input/OS cursor creation and wake bypass GPU actor completion. Source-level ownership is sound; live stopped-GPU acceptance remains pending.
